essence: The unit establishes a fourfold salutation to the venerable sacred sandals.
The worship of Kālī’s venerable sandals is prescribed together with the fish seal and liṅga-yoni observance.
After invoking the venerable sandals in the six-cornered circle, one should worship once and bow with the stated seal.
The formula combines the bīja nhrīṁ, invocation of Niśeśvarī, and reverence to the venerable sandals in a counted ritual recitation.
